decision: No new integration candidate. Hip opening introduces a second correction-gain discontinuity, but removing it does not improve achieved catch velocity. In-flight stationary-point arrival braking systematically trades the earlier position gain for lower speed. Earlier yaw alone does not increase translation under the low request. Do not boost physical turning or claim YAC is fixed.
